parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "student_id": "{{ $json.body.studentId || 'demo-001' }}",
  "topic": "{{ $json.body.topic || 'Linear Equations' }}",
  "question": "{{ $json.body.question }}",
  "expected_answer": "{{ $json.body.expectedAnswer }}",
  "student_answer": "{{ $json.body.studentAnswer }}",
  "steps": "{{ Array.isArray($json.body.steps) ? $json.body.steps.join('\n') : $json.body.steps }}",
  "verdict": "{{ $json.body.studentAnswer.includes('x = 5') ? 'correct' : 'incorrect' }}",
  "misconception_type": "{{ $json.body.studentAnswer.includes('x = 5') ? null : 'invalid_inverse_operation' }}",
  "feedback_level": {{ $json.body.attemptNumber || 1 }},
  "feedback": "{{ $json.body.studentAnswer.includes('x = 5') ? 'Great job! You isolated x correctly.' : 'Check the operation applied to both sides when isolating the variable.' }}",
  "retry_question": "Solve 4x + 7 = 23",
  "confidence": 0.88
}
